title: County's wildfire lawsuits and global settlement
summary: On May 19, 2026, a council committee voted 8-0, with one member excused, to advance Resolution 26-82 to the full council. It adds $240,000 to pay the law firm Myers-Nave for August 2023 wildfire lawsuit work, for a total of up to $740,000. The insurer agreed to pay $521,000 of the firm's $854,000 bill.

timeline.text: Resolution 26-82, referral to committee: The council referred a resolution on extra pay for special counsel in wildfire lawsuits to the Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee.
The council approved the settlement recommendation.
A member said she hopes the settlement brings closure and comfort to the fire victims.
The committee voted 6-0 to recommend adopting the settlement resolution.
The County's lawyers must send the council a twice-yearly report on future cases settled under the settlement resolution.
The committee amended the resolution so the settlement covers claims from the Lahaina and Upcountry wildfires.
The committee had met in executive session (a closed-door discussion) with its lawyers.
The council is acting on a global settlement of wildfire lawsuits against the County from the August 2023 wildfires.
